items.summary: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
The five prayers are like bathing in a river at your door five times a day.
Ḥadīth qudsī: even if your sins reached the clouds, then you sought forgiveness, I would forgive you.
He ﷺ sought Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.
Sayyid al-Istighfār — the best way to ask forgiveness.
Unsure of 3 or 4 rakʿahs? Build on certainty and make two prostrations before salām.
